description: Negative: cascade:ProxyAgent missing the required cascade:proxyRelationship property (core v3.3)
shaclConstraintViolated: ProxyAgentShape requires cascade:proxyRelationship (sh:minCount 1, sh:datatype xsd:string). A ProxyAgent that does not declare its relationship to the patient (e.g. parent, guardian, caregiver) violates the minCount constraint and is rejected.
notes: Derived from cascade:ProxyAgentShape (core v3.3), which mandates cascade:actsForPatient, cascade:proxyRelationship, and cascade:proxyGrantedAt. This fixture supplies actsForPatient and proxyGrantedAt but omits proxyRelationship.
